title: Identity component reduces to the canonical unitor composite
statement: theorem systemRefinement_id_component_to_unitor (X Y : CondensedERealization.Base k) (f : X.scheme ⟶ Y.scheme) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] (c : Compactification f) (M : coefficientSequenceDerived.{u, u} l E X.scheme) (hγ : GammaIdentityCondition l E k f c) : (systemRefinement l E k X Y f (Compactification.Refinement.id c)).app M = (Functor.leftUnitor (systemSupport l E c)).hom.app M ≫ (Functor.leftUnitor (systemSupport l E c)).inv.app M
